messages:
Priya (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the observability scope for next sprint. customer asks + launch criteria only, please.
Jose (GTM): +1 — sales flagged two customers needing cost breakdown per-route and error slice reports by EOW.
Maya (Eng): can we be explicit: are we shipping dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics in the same ship?
Priya (PM): not everything. proposal: dash templates + minimal tracing hooks (inbound/outbound span) + cost per-route pod-level metric + error-rate heatmap. keep advanced anomaly detection for v2.
Ben (SRE): love the conservative cut. acceptance: dashboards render within 3s for 90% queries, traces sampled <= 10% by default, cost breakdown accurate to +-5% at daily rollup.
Camila (Design): for dashboards we need 3 templates: cost, latency, error-slice. will mock today. want a small guided tour for customers.
Alice (Eng-ML): PT: error-slice needs deterministic grouping rules (status, model, prompt-tag) — we should add standardized tags in API.
Maya (Eng): agree on tags. engineering ask: add header X-rlw-customer : string and X-model-id so we can route traces and attribute tokens. small SDK change.
Priya (PM): noted. prioritize SDK header + tagging in scope. can we do feature-flag rollout?
Maya (Eng): yes — route: feature flag 'obs:metadata-headers' with gradual rollout. fallback if header missing uses best-effort attribution.
Ben (SRE): canary policy: enable in 1% customer traffic, monitor trace export rate + CPU delta, escalate at >10% CPU increase or trace export >3x baseline. DeployBot: Canary started for obs:metadata-headers at 1%.
Jose (GTM): timeline ask: if we commit to these acceptance criteria, can we promise early access next week for those two customers?
Maya (Eng): if SDK header + templates by Fri, we can cut early access build Mon. needs 2 reviewers.
Camila (Design): will deliver templates by Thursday EOD and sample copy for the tour.
Alice (Eng-ML): I'll draft grouping heuristics + simple eval to verify slices before rollout.
Priya (PM): launch acceptance checklist (short):
- feature flag enabled and canaried (yes)
- dashboards: 3 templates + tour (Camila)
- tracing hooks: header-based spans + sampling controls (Maya)
- cost breakdown: per-route daily rollup within +-5% (SRE + Finance)
- error analytics: slice grouping + UI filters (Alice + Camila)
- docs + SDK release notes (DevEx)
If all green, ship beta to customers.
Ben (SRE): one more: monitoring alerts for instrumentation regressions (token export spike, span size, ingestion error). add to runbook.
Priya (PM): yes, add to runbook and create an incident playbook.
Jose (GTM): I'll coordinate customer comms and capture exact asks so we don't overcommit.
Maya (Eng): blocking items: small infra quota for trace export and an extra kafka partition for short-term buffering. tagging infra ticket #INF-864.
Priya (PM): thanks — owners: Maya (engineering), Camila (design), Alice (grouping logic), Ben (SRE/runbook), Jose (customer), Priya (PM). next sync Fri 10am.
Camila (Design): :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Canary at 1% complete, no errors observed.
